answer: A provisional identity earns full weight only after a staggered liveness voyage: over seven days the beacon summons it at three unpredictable moments, each demanding a fresh signature and a gesture naming the shown word within five minutes. A farm must staff every fake identity day and night, so cost grows per identity, and a missed summons at the nadir of night still counts. Schedules appear only as salted hashes, so replies cannot be precomputed; repeated failures burn the bond and flag the garden of linked accounts for audit. Shift workers get one grace window, but grace cannot be banked.
